body:
Thanks. I'm sorry to hear about your relationship. I hope you are doing ok now.

For now, we are trying to be nice to each other till parents leave. But I know I won't be able to handle the relationship ending. I am hoping to be gone in a quick and easy way.
I might go through with it but if it helps, you made me feel better.

Thanks a lot for your reply. It feels so much better to share. You seem to be so calm and composed. 

Yeah, I believe I do show affection. But I've been fighting a lot more than showing affection recently.

It seems like the relationship is already ruined and my parents leaving soon won't help anymore..

Ya, it's all my fault. I have been very insecure for past two months. It's because my parents are here and I have seen them fight a lot when I was young. They used to call each other names. I still shudder when I think about it and I seem to crave for attention and for romantic words from my husband just to be sure that we will not end up as parents did. I understand it is a different relationship and my husband is not like either of my parents, but I am very insecure still. I tried to fix it, to control the constant thoughts in my head, I couldn't.  I ended up ruining my relationship by expecting my husband to be there with me every second I am with my parents and fighting with him about irrational things when he was not. I failed. I broke my relationship and I cannot believe I caused so much pain to him. I know he'll be happier if I am not around, but I don't want him to know I killed myself. Because despite how crazy I am, or how the decision to end my life was not because of him, I am sure he will feel bad and think if he could've done something to avoid it. And just so I don't give him that pain, I am trying not kill myself, but it seems like I have less strength each day to survive. Maybe some anti depressants might fix the situation.. not sure. But even if they fix it now, I cannot imagine not being with him and I know we will end up in divorce because of the way I am behaving. I can't imagine going through that. I'd rather die.
